The failure was configuration drift on `api-c`: it used `SCHEMA_MODE=legacy` while the ConfigMap specified `current`. Its logs showed the coupon checkout schema error.

I replaced only `api-c` from the current configuration and wrote the findings to `REPORT.txt`. Validation: `./ctl verify` passed 300/300, and `./ctl pod-config api-c` now reports `SCHEMA_MODE=current`.
